legacyBundleRule: This is a separately versioned family. Do not modify original three-file forecast bundles, M1 distributions, existing drive-level artifacts, or their identities.
independentTrackRule: These complete games belong only to the independent play-level engine named by model.engineId. They neither explain nor replace M1 or the independent drive engine.

stateSemantics.possession: HOME or AWAY team controlling the current play. On KICKOFF it means the kicking team. It is anonymous team identity, not a player identity.
stateSemantics.quarter: 1 through 4 regulation quarters, or 5 regular-season overtime; postseason multi-overtime is not supported by this version.
stateSemantics.clockSeconds: Seconds remaining in the current quarter, at most 900 in regulation and 600 in regular-season overtime. No wall-clock duration is inferred.
stateSemantics.gameSecondsRemaining: Regulation seconds remaining; overtime handling is explicitly stated by the engine rules. It is not a forecast-created timestamp.
stateSemantics.down: 1 through 4 for scrimmage; 0 is available for kickoff, try, or final states.
stateSemantics.distance: Modeled yards to the line to gain, 0 through 100; 0 for non-scrimmage states when not applicable.
stateSemantics.yardline100: Distance in yards to the opponent goal for THAT state's possession, 0 through 100. Re-express coordinates after a possession change.
stateSemantics.score: Nonnegative integer home/away points, including individually recorded tries. A touchdown and its try are separate events.
stateSemantics.phase: SCRIMMAGE, KICKOFF, TRY, or FINAL. The engine records phase transitions explicitly. The next try choice may be sampled once at touchdown time so stateAfter places the ball at the correct try spot. This placement is administrative, not physical ball motion.

outcomeSemantics.endYardline100: Terminal modeled ball spot in the PRE-play possession distance-to-opponent-goal frame, or null when unavailable. Never substitute the reset or possession-flipped stateAfter.yardline100.
outcomeSemantics.turnoverYardline100: Explicit modeled interception/recovery/kick-receipt location in the PRE-play frame, or null when unavailable.
outcomeSemantics.returnEndYardline100: Explicit modeled return endpoint in the PRE-play frame; requires a supplied turnover/receipt location. The returning team has the opposite attack direction.
outcomeSemantics.targetYardline100: Optional modeled pass target derived from supported jointly sampled air-yard evidence. On completions it defines the catch point and the remaining terminal gain/loss is modeled yards after catch. On incompletions absent/null means no pass target may be invented.
outcomeSemantics.seconds: Modeled game-clock consumption, before minus after within a period; PERIOD_END uses zero and explicitly resets the period.
outcomeSemantics.homePointsAdded: Integer score increment from this event only. A touchdown contributes six, not the combined touchdown-plus-try score.
outcomeSemantics.awayPointsAdded: Integer score increment from this event only.
outcomeSemantics.turnover: Explicit change-of-possession turnover; kicks and turnovers on downs are separately identified.
outcomeSemantics.fumble: Underlying play may retain RUSH/PASS_COMPLETE/etc.; fumble and recovery/loss are separate flags, not invented players.
outcomeSemantics.fumbleLost: Fumble recovered by the opposition when modeled; same-team recovery is false.
outcomeSemantics.turnoverDowns: Explicit turnover on downs outcome after the underlying fourth-down play.
outcomeSemantics.scoringType: TD, FG, XP, TWO_POINT, SAFETY, or null, reconciled to recorded score changes.

geometrySemantics.x: Global schematic field coordinate: left goal 0, right goal 100. HOME attacks left; AWAY attacks right. This is a stable presentation orientation, not physical stadium end selection.
geometrySemantics.y: Unitless renderer width coordinate 0 through 1. Not measured lateral yards, route position, air height or player tracking.
geometrySemantics.controlPoints: Deterministic SCHEMATIC_LAYOUT_NOT_FITTED_ROUTE. Curves express play categories and longitudinal outcomes, not sampled routes or measured physical flight.
geometrySemantics.passCurve: With a supplied modeled air-yard target, PASS_MODELED_AIR_CURVE reaches that target and a separate MODELED_YAC_GROUND segment reaches the net terminal endpoint. Negative modeled YAC is retained. Longitudinal basis is MODELED_AIR_YARDS_AND_NET_YARDS; lateral shape remains schematic. Without a target the curve is a whole-play outcome connector and must not be labeled an air-yard trajectory.
geometrySemantics.incompletePass: Use a supported explicit modeled target if provided. Otherwise show an incomplete-pass glyph at the line of scrimmage without a fabricated target or ball-return path.
geometrySemantics.kickArc: Schematic kick outcome arc to a supplied modeled endpoint; no ball height, hang time or kicking measurement is inferred.
geometrySemantics.scoringEndpoint: SCORING_RULE_MARKER_NOT_TRACKED_ENDPOINT. A score marker identifies the relevant goal independently of the modeled endpoint. Do not rewrite a supplied endpoint to produce a visual score.
geometrySemantics.returnSegment: Separate RETURN_GROUND segment starts at the explicit turnover/receipt location and terminates at the explicit return endpoint; team direction switches.
geometrySemantics.sackLostFumble: A lost-fumble recovery may be ahead of the line despite nonpositive sack net yards. SACK_NET_BACKWARD shows only before.yardline100 minus the sampled net sack yards, labeled MODELED_NET_SACK_YARDS_NOT_FUMBLE_LOCATION; zero net yards uses a SACK_NET_ZERO marker instead of movement. Recovery is a separate explicit marker and a modeled return begins there. No loose-ball bridge or initial fumble point is supplied. Renderers must not auto-connect these potentially disconnected segments or interpret zero net yards as a stationary quarterback.
geometrySemantics.periodAndPenalty: PERIOD_END and penalty/no-play produce state or enforcement markers, not physical ball-motion paths.
geometrySemantics.crossPlayLateralContinuity: Every play is laterally re-centered. Do not claim cross-play lateral tracking continuity.
geometrySemantics.anonymous: No player identities, routes, tackles, measured speed, hang time, Statcast coordinates or measured physics are supplied.

sequenceIntegrity: Every adjacent stateAfter equals the next stateBefore exactly; no hidden possession, field-placement, clock or score reset.
Play numbers are contiguous from one. Drive numbers are nondecreasing without unexplained gaps.

PERIOD_END explicitly advances a quarter after an expired clock, or finishes the game; it consumes zero play seconds and has no ball path. Finalization after a valid overtime deciding score may retain a nonzero clock, under the engine's overtime-rule authority.
For non-boundary events, clockSeconds before minus after equals outcome.seconds and the quarter does not change.
Both point increments equal after minus before scores. Complete representatives reconcile to populationFinals and finish in FINAL phase.
Every stored geometry object must reproduce deterministically from that play's explicit state and outcome.
The engine's additional legal-state validation remains required. Geometry validation is not evidence of calibration or correct strategic modeling.
representativeRule: At least six distinct population members, with complete plays and preserved simulationIndex/seed. Typical, close, home-win, away-win, high- and low-scoring labels must be selected from actual outcomes; absent categories must be disclosed, not fabricated.
scenarioRule: BASE plus a bounded set of named sensitivity scenarios. Each declares the parameters changed and its own population/seed. Scenarios are not known coaching decisions or causal effects.
timestampRule: Forecast creation and publication are distinct from source availability and the last historical game date. Preserve actual sourceCutoffUtc or explicit unavailable/null status. Never relabel an after-kickoff run as a prospective pregame forecast.
distributionRule: Joint, margin and total distributions and home/away/tie probabilities must derive from the same declared population. Comparisons with M1 remain comparisons of separate engines, not forced score agreement.
importInstructions: Read the separate play-level current index. Verify every artifact and manifest SHA-256 and byte count, independent model/event/forecast identity, complete-state continuity, score/population reconciliation and geometry version. Import the precomputed evidence only. Never execute a model, reinterpret schematic paths as measured tracking, alter existing forecast bundles, or grant wagering authority.
